question: Muharram is the _______ month of the Islamic Calendar and is considered a holy month.
solution:
The correct answer is __**first**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Muharram** is the first month of the Islamic Calendar.
 
• It is considered a holy month, second only to Ramadan in its significance in Islam.
 
• Muharram marks the beginning of the Islamic New Year.
